description: Node's byte container, a subclass of `Uint8Array` with `from`, `alloc`, `concat`, `byteLength` and `toString(encoding)`.
The default text encoding on the wire and on disk: 1 to 4 bytes per character, so `text.length` is not the byte size.
Represents bytes with 64 printable characters (about 4/3 the size). An encoding for text formats, **not** encryption.
Two characters per byte (`0-9a-f`). Common for hashes and ids.
`�` (U+FFFD) appears when invalid or incomplete UTF-8 is decoded, typically a character split across chunks.
`for (const char of text)` yields whole characters, including emoji made of two UTF-16 code units.
